KUZUNGUMZA KWA UFASAHA MJADALA KUTOKANA NA MASUALA YA KIMATAIFA — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRAC
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — topic synthesis and prac means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Kuzungumza kwa Ufasaha Mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Watch closely at a duka counter in Mombasa. On “Kuzungumza kwa Ufasaha Mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — Topi”, learners often mix up kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa with a nearby idea. Keep this accurate line instead: Kujadili miktadha ambamo mijadala hutokea katika jamii,. Supporting detail: ● kushiriki kwenye mjadala na.

MAIN NOTES
----
• ● kushiriki kwenye mjadala na.
• ● kurekodi mjadala alioshiriki.
• ● kusikiliza mjadala aliorekodi.
• Pia naporekodi mjadala wanaoshiriki kwao.
• ● kujadili miktadha mbalimbali.
• Vikao mbalimbali vya kijamii.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a school compound in Machakos: a learner investigates kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — topic synthesis and prac within Kuzungumza kwa Ufasaha Mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa.
First, state the idea clearly: ● kushiriki kwenye mjadala na.
Next, apply it to one object or action at a school compound in Machakos and name what changes or what stays the same.
Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for KISWAHILI.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
At a school compound in Machakos, practise kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — topic synthesis and prac during ordinary routines at home or school. Ask: what did I observe, which word or formula fits, and how do I check I am right? Use the diagram or working on this page as your model. Safety and respect come first.

SUMMARY
----
• ● kushiriki kwenye mjadala na.
• ● kurekodi mjadala alioshiriki.
• ● kusikiliza mjadala aliorekodi.
• Pia naporekodi mjadala wanaoshiriki kwao.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — topic synthesis and prac in your own words and give one clear example.
2. Describe a situation at a school compound in Machakos that shows Kuzungumza kwa Ufasaha Mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — topic synthesis and prac. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----
1. ● kushiriki kwenye mjadala na. Example: connect it to something real at home, school, market, or a school compound in Machakos.
2. At a school compound in Machakos, observe carefully, name the correct idea from Kuzungumza kwa Ufasaha Mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa, and explain with one subject fact from the main notes.
3. Wrong idea: mixing kuzungumza kwa ufasaha mjadala kutokana na masuala ya kimataifa — topic synthesis and prac with a neighbouring concept or skipping the method. Correct idea: Kujadili miktadha ambamo mijadala hutokea katika jamii,. Justification: follow the worked example (and diagram if shown) on this page.
